text:
mira: Quick copy huddle for tri-mode landing variants — aiming to finalize hosted/dedicated/private lines today.
noah: Idea: lean into one core value per mode. Hosted = "fastest-to-prod", Dedicated = "predictable performance", Private = "compliance-first control". Short, punchy.
talia: Agree. Propose microcopy for each hero: Hosted: 'Ship LLM features in hours.' Dedicated: 'Reserved capacity, predictable costs.' Private: 'Deploy in your VPC, keep control.'
ben: Add subheads focused on cost levers e.g., 'Autoscaling, batching, and quantization to lower unit cost' as tertiary line. Keep it optional.
gerrit: Can we call out the webinar on the hero as a small ribbon? "Live webinar: Serving LLMs at scale" with CTA "Reserve seat". Good for top-of-funnel.
mira: Yes. We'll A/B the ribbon vs no ribbon. Also we need routing: Hosted "Get API key", Dedicated "Talk to sales", Private "Request on-prem info".
noah: For analytics: capture 'deployment_interest' and 'model_scale' on the demo signup. Makes attribution easier.
talia: Also make sure the benchmark claim is conservative: use 'average token latency ~80ms (short chats)'. ben: I'll get confirmation from runtime team.
gerrit: For SEO, combine pages into one canonical tri-mode page with anchors for each mode. Less content duplication.
mira: Ok I'll update the CMS. marketing-bot: Reminder: content freeze at 5pm PT.
noah: Small copy ask: avoid internal acronyms in public-facing lines.
talia: Got it. Will push three hero drafts into the doc now.
ben: I'll follow up with a one-paragraph notes block for security team to repurpose on Private page.
